I keep losing track of which pull requests are waiting on me. Can we make a single morning list?
model
A daily sheet could group every ready PR into 'decide' and 'merge if you agree', with one line on what each changes.
human
Yes, and grey drafts should stay off it. I only look at green.
model
Then lanes mark finished work ready for review, and drafts mean an agent is still working.
human
The sourdough starter smelled like nail polish remover this morning.
model
An acetone smell usually means the starter is hungry. Feed it more often or at a higher ratio of flour.
human
I fed it twice and the smell went away, so the hunger theory held.
model
Good. Keep the twice-daily feeding while the kitchen stays warm.
human
Should branches stack on top of unmerged branches?
model
Stacking lets work continue, but a rejected base forces every branch above it to be rebuilt.
human
Then no stacking. Always branch from main and wait if you depend on something unmerged.
model
Understood: every branch starts from the default branch.
human
Planning the trip to Lisbon in March; I want two days for the tile museum and the tram.
model
The Azulejo museum is closed on Mondays, so put it on a Tuesday. Tram 28 is busiest mid-morning.
human
Trip moved to May because of the conference.
model
May is warmer and the jacaranda trees bloom late in the month.
human
How should memory facts age? A plan becomes a past event at some point.
model
Keep a tense on each claim: planned, ongoing, done or lapsed. A passed date without evidence becomes lapsed, never done.
human
I like lapsed. Never silently assume something happened.
model
Then aging is always a recorded revision citing either new evidence or the passed date.
human
My knee aches after long runs on concrete.
model
Softer surfaces and a shorter long run for two weeks are a common first step; see a physiotherapist if it persists.
human
Switched to the gravel trail and the ache faded.
model
Keep the gravel trail for the long runs and build distance slowly.
human
Paste from the other thread: 'Stacking lets work continue, but a rejected base forces every branch above it to be rebuilt.' Is that still our view?
model
Yes. That reasoning led to the no-stacking rule: branch from main.
human
Good. Also the reviewer from the other model family should check claims, not the one who proposed them.
model
A challenger from a different family reduces the chance that one model's blind spot confirms itself.
human
Which embedding should Anamnesis use, a local model or a provider?
model
Test a local model first and keep a provider behind the same interface, recording the model id on every vector.
human
Agreed. Store the text, vectors and provenance on our side.
model
Then a re-embed with a new model becomes a new index rather than an overwrite.
